deltas.why: `hidden` is a global HTML attribute; a chip carrying it would not render at all. Rename only — the state is unchanged.
`id` is the host element's own HTML id. A screen reaching for its card by id would overwrite the record's citation number with a DOM handle, and print it on the record. Rename only.

It succeeds the 0.4.0 live-component receipt and its Q6/Q10 rulings without removing or renaming anything.
